Your refund of **€310** for the incorrect hardware shipment (originally sent to Rotterdam DC-FY88, corrected shipment site: **Pune DC**) has been approved and processed. The refund is aligned with your contract terms and is now in the accounting pipeline.

Thank you for your patience. Please confirm receipt of the fix.

— IT Operations Support
